title: Diameter estimates and Hitchin-Thorpe inequality for four-dimensional compact Quasi-Einstein manifolds
summary: We study compact $m$-quasi-Einstein manifolds and derive geometric estimates relating the oscillation of the potential function to the diameter of the manifold. We obtain lower bounds for the diameter in terms of the oscillation of the potential function. As an application in dimension four, we derive diameter conditions ensuring that compact $m$-quasi-Einstein manifolds satisfy the Hitchin--Thorpe inequality.
